claim: Intel's first-quarter 2026 revenue rose 7% year over year.
summary: The claim concerns Intel's Q1 2026 revenue growth of 7% YoY. The model's knowledge cutoff is 2026-01-04, which is before the end of Q1 2026 (March 31, 2026) and its typical earnings release in late April 2026. Therefore there is no available information to verify or contradict the reported revenue or the 7% change.

sub_claims.text: Intel reported revenue for the first quarter of 2026
sub_claims.note: Knowledge cutoff 2026-01-04 predates Q1 2026 period end and earnings release, so existence and value of Q1 2026 revenue cannot be verified.

sub_claims.text: Intel's first-quarter 2026 revenue was 7% higher than its first-quarter 2025 revenue
sub_claims.note: No Q1 2026 financial results are available within the pre-cutoff knowledge base; the claimed 7% year-over-year increase can neither be supported nor contradicted without tools.
